definitions.explanation: A male performer in film, television, or theater. Used mainly in formal contexts and award names where the distinction between male and female performers is relevant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{男優|だんゆう}だ。
examples.english: He is a popular male actor.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{助演|じょえん}→助演：18098_joen⟧{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He won Best Supporting Actor for that work.

examples.japanese: ⟦アカデミー→アカデミー：10751_akademii⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Academy Award for Best Actor is one of the most prestigious awards in the film industry.

notes:
Compound of {男|だん} (male) + ⟦{優|ゆう}→優：00431_yuu⟧ (actor; the final character of ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}: Best Actor award
- ⟦{助演|じょえん}→助演：18098_joen⟧{男優賞|だんゆうしょう}: Best Supporting Actor award
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{男優|だんゆう}: popular actor
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧{男優|だんゆう}: young/up-and-coming actor

USAGE:
Less common in everyday speech than the gender-neutral ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧ (actor) — most Japanese speakers refer to a male actor simply as ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧. {男優|だんゆう} is used mainly when the male/female distinction matters, such as in award titles or industry reporting.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: actor — gender-neutral, the default term
- ⟦{女優|じょゆう}→女優：03353_joyuu⟧: actress — the female counterpart, used more frequently than {男優|だんゆう}
- ⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧: actor (especially in stage or traditional theater)
